seed_claims.claim: Klein's own matrices contain diag(z^4, z^2, z), not D

Klein's 1878 paper itself was not read; note LNR call the mirror form xy^3+yz^3+zx^3 'Klein's quartic', so 'Klein's own copy' is a coordinate-labelling convention.

seed_claims.claim: the copy holding <D, 120 deg turn> is Klein's conjugated by -(x<->z), and preserves xy^3+yz^3+zx^3
seed_claims.evidence: exact set equality; it is also LNR's published basis, and it is the unique PSL(2,7) in U(3) containing <D, C> (argument closed by computed facts: Aut(F21) induced by PGL(2,7), degree equation).

Cited, not recomputed: the group-level statement that the stabiliser of e in G2 is exactly SU(3) (Gunaydin-Gursey 1973).

seed_claims.evidence: Lambda ⋊ D6 with Coxeter (2,3,6); site symmetries 6mm, 3m (x2), 2mm (x3) per cell.

seed_claims.claim: those turns keep the seven points (x -> 5x, 6x, 3x) but swap the two Fano families
seed_claims.evidence: exact; the 60/180/300 deg turns are x -> 5x, 6x, 3x.

seed_claims.claim: no mirror in either group keeps the seven points
seed_claims.evidence: 0 of 3 and 0 of 6; also no mirror of either affine Weyl group. Reason: the 7-vertex torus is chiral (all 42 automorphisms preserve orientation); SU(3)'s mirrors swap D's order-7 subgroup with diag(z,z^4,z^2)'s.

seed_claims.claim: F21, PSL(2,7) and the Fano split belong to the SU(3) rung; the turns completing p6m arrive with G2 and swap the families; they don't stack into one clean tower
seed_claims.evidence: every factual clause holds (verdict changed from AMENDED in the reconciliation, Oct 19: the amendment concerned interpretation, not fact). Wording refinement suggested: the groups do form a chain G2 ⊃ SU(3)⋊Z2 ⊃ PGL(2,7) ⊃ PSL(2,7) ⊃ F21, because the family-swapping G2 turn (180 deg = complex conjugation kappa) normalises the flipped PSL(2,7) and gives PGL(2,7) = Aut(PSL(2,7)) of order 336 inside G2 (kappa C^{±1} realise the 60 and 300 deg turns); the two Fano families are the two classes of S4, which this outer automorphism swaps, so the family split survives only up to PSL(2,7), as the seed says.
